post.summary: Get call History for selected campaign
post.description: Get call history for selected campaign

Search call history for a campaign. Mandatory: filters[0].equalFilters.campaignid and filters[0].rangeFilters.date_added (epoch ms). Optional top-level: searchText (phone or call id with -vcall-), sortFields, customFilters. Customer filter: multiValueEqualFilters.customerIds only (not equalFilters.customerId). fieldsToReturn is ignored.

requestBody.description: See named examples for each supported filter field

get.summary: Get Transferable Agents List (for Transfer Operations)
get.description: Get All Transferable Agents from ALL campaigns for transfer operations. This endpoint shows agents across different campaigns that can receive transferred calls. For 4x accounts, calls the getAllUserCampaignVoicePresencesByContactCenterId API which returns users from all campaigns. For 6x accounts, uses Redis-based monitoring data.

parameters.name: app-instance-id
parameters.description:
App instance id filter

Note: app-instance-id filter works with user-roles filter in OR precedence.
This means that if either of the filters matches the criteria, the API will return the result

get.summary: Query aggregated statistical data for a stats table
get.description: Fetch aggregated data from the stats table using filters, groupings, and metric aggregations like SUM, AVG, COUNT, etc.

parameters.description: Time range filter in JSON format. Example: {"$gt":{"$date":"$now:-1d"}}

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Additional filters in JSON format. Example: {"$and":[{"status":"active"}]}

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Grouping and aggregation in JSON format. Example: {"time":"1h","aggregate":["COUNT:call_count"]}

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Ordering in JSON format. Example: ["field1 ASC","field2 DESC"]

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return (max: 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination
